title: Landon Dickerson feels he let team down in his return to lineup

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Landon Dickerson feels he let team down in his return to lineup
sources.description: The Eagles got left guard Landon Dickerson back in the lineup for Monday night's game against the Cowboys, but his return wasn't enough to snap the team's losing streak.
